name: Best Pacific International Holdings Limited
summary: Best Pacific International Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, trades in, and sells elastic fabric, elastic webbing, and lace. It operates in Manufacturing and Trading of Elastic Fabric and Lace; and Manufacturing and Trading of Elastic Webbing Segments. The company offers elastic fabric and lace for use in knitted lingerie, sportswear, and apparel products; and elastic webbing that are used as shoulder straps, lingerie trims, and waistbands.
